name: Abrasive Drag

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Requirements You are mounted and have a creature Grabbed or Restrained.

---
Your mount attempts an Athletics check to trip the creature you've grabbed or restrained, then Strides. The grabbed or restrained creature keeps that condition and is pulled to a space within your reach. This is forced movement. If the grabbed or restrained creature is Prone, it takes 2 slashing damage for every 5 feet it moved.
